imp_settings.marker.brain.note: Marker above the Imp's head and panel title.

imp_settings.marker.look.note: Marker left of the Imp: colour, size and character.

imp_settings.marker.personality.note: Marker right of the Imp: name, persona and voice.

imp_settings.marker.animations.note: Marker below the Imp: its animations.

imp_settings.list.label.note: Spoken name of the rail of sections of one Imp's settings.

imp_settings.value.asleep.note: Short value in the settings list when the Imp has no Brain.

imp_settings.value.tools.note: Short value in the settings list: tools on out of all, like 17/26.

imp_settings.brain_marker.asleep.note: Screen reader label of the unlit Brain marker.
imp_settings.brain_marker.asleep.en: {name} is asleep. Give it a Brain.
imp_settings.brain_marker.asleep.zh-Hans: {name} 睡着了。给它一个大脑吧。

imp_settings.share.note: Icon button label in the top corner.

imp_settings.share.a11y.note: Screen reader label of the share button.

imp_settings.goodbye.note: Icon button label in the top corner.

imp_settings.goodbye.a11y.note: Screen reader label of the goodbye button.

goodbye.title.note: Title of the dialog that asks before saying goodbye to an Imp.

goodbye.message.en: Its look, Brain settings, tools, triggers and chats go with it. This can't be undone.
goodbye.message.es: Su aspecto, los ajustes de su cerebro, sus herramientas, disparadores y chats se van con él. No se puede deshacer.
goodbye.message.zh-Hans: 它的外观、大脑设置、工具、触发器和聊天都会一起消失。此操作无法撤销。

goodbye.confirm.note: Destructive button of the goodbye dialog.

goodbye.cancel.note: Safe button of the goodbye dialog.

goodbye.many.title.note: Title of the dialog that asks before saying goodbye to several Imps.
goodbye.many.title.zh-Hans: 要向 {count} 个 Imp 说再见吗？

goodbye.many.message.note: Message of the goodbye dialog for several Imps, under their names.
goodbye.many.message.en: Their looks, Brain settings, tools, triggers and chats go with them. This can't be undone.
goodbye.many.message.es: Su aspecto, los ajustes de su cerebro, sus herramientas, disparadores y chats se van con ellos. No se puede deshacer.
goodbye.many.message.zh-Hans: 它们的外观、大脑设置、工具、触发器和聊天都会一起消失。此操作无法撤销。

goodbye.many.cancel.note: Safe button of the goodbye dialog for several Imps.

look.character.note: Slider group label: small traits of how the Imp moves and looks around.

look.character_hint.en: Small traits that change how {name} moves and looks around.
look.character_hint.es: Pequeños rasgos que cambian cómo se mueve y mira {name}.
look.character_hint.zh-Hans: 一些小特点，会改变 {name} 的动作和目光。

look.preview.note: Label of the live Imp above the sliders.

look.reset.note: Button that restores the default look.

personality.name_hint.en: Part of who {name} is. You can change it any time.
personality.name_hint.es: Parte de quién es {name}. Puedes cambiarlo cuando quieras.
personality.name_hint.zh-Hans: 这是 {name} 个性的一部分，随时可以修改。

personality.name_empty.note: Error when the name is empty.
personality.name_empty.es: Dale un nombre a tu Imp.
personality.name_empty.zh-Hans: 给你的 Imp 起个名字吧。

personality.persona.note: Field label for the text that tells the Imp who it is.

personality.persona_hint.en: Tell {name} who it is and how it talks.
personality.persona_hint.es: Cuéntale a {name} quién es y cómo habla.
personality.persona_hint.zh-Hans: 告诉 {name} 它是谁，以及怎么说话。

brain.hint.note: Hint at the top of the Brain panel.
brain.hint.en: A Brain is a service and a model. {name} thinks with it.
brain.hint.es: Un cerebro es un servicio y un modelo. {name} piensa con él.
brain.hint.zh-Hans: 大脑由一项服务和一个模型组成。{name} 用它来思考。

brain.use_app.note: Choice: use the app's default Brain.

brain.use_own.note: Choice: this Imp has its own service and model.

brain.add_service.note: Button that adds a Brain service.

brain.check_ok.note: Result of a successful Brain check.

brain.checking.note: Shown while a Brain is checked.

brain.zzz.note: Screen reader description of the sleeping animation.

tools.group_count.note: Under a tool group: how many of its tools are on.

tools.group_off.note: Under a tool group that is switched off.

tools.group_switch.note: Screen reader name of a tool group switch.

tools.empty.note: Empty state of the tools list.

triggers.switch.note: Screen reader name of a trigger switch.

triggers.empty.note: Empty state of the triggers list.

animations.empty.note: Empty state of the animations list.

imp_settings.this_imp.note: Stands in for the Imp's name while its name is empty.

brain.source.note: Row: whose Brain the Imp uses.

brain.help.source.note: Help of the Brain source switch.
brain.help.source.en: Use the Brain every Imp shares, or pick a different one just for this Imp.
brain.help.source.es: Usa el Cerebro que comparten todos los Imps, o elige otro solo para este Imp.
brain.help.source.zh-Hans: 使用所有 Imp 共用的大脑，或只为这个 Imp 选另一个。

brain.help.service.en: Pick who does the thinking for this Imp.
brain.help.service.es: Elige quién piensa por este Imp.
brain.help.service.zh-Hans: 选择由谁来为这个 Imp 思考。

brain.help.key.en: A secret password that lets the Imp use this service. It stays on this Mac.
brain.help.key.es: Una contraseña secreta que deja al Imp usar este servicio. Se queda en este Mac.
brain.help.key.zh-Hans: 一个秘密口令，让 Imp 可以使用这项服务。它只保存在这台 Mac 上。

brain.help.model.en: The exact brain of the service. Bigger ones think better but are slower.
brain.help.model.es: El cerebro concreto del servicio. Los grandes piensan mejor pero van más lentos.
brain.help.model.zh-Hans: 服务里具体用哪个大脑。大的想得更好，但更慢。

brain.help.add_service.note: Tooltip of the add service button.

look.help.body.en: Pick the colour and the size of this Imp.
look.help.body.es: Elige el color y el tamaño de este Imp.
look.help.body.zh-Hans: 选择这个 Imp 的颜色和大小。

look.favourite.note: Tooltip of the favourite colour button.

look.help.colour.en: The colour of this Imp. Drag along the strip to change it.
look.help.colour.es: El color de este Imp. Arrastra por la tira para cambiarlo.
look.help.colour.zh-Hans: 这个 Imp 的颜色。沿着色条拖动来改变。

look.help.size.en: How big this Imp is on your screen.
look.help.size.es: Qué tan grande es este Imp en tu pantalla.
look.help.size.zh-Hans: 这个 Imp 在屏幕上有多大。

look.help.character.en: Small touches that change the face and the way it moves.
look.help.character.es: Pequeños detalles que cambian la cara y su forma de moverse.
look.help.character.zh-Hans: 一些改变脸和动作样子的小细节。

look.help.lids.en: How closed the eyelids are. More makes it look sleepy.
look.help.lids.es: Cuánto se cierran los párpados. Cuanto más se cierran, más dormido parece.
look.help.lids.zh-Hans: 眼皮合上的程度。越多越像没睡醒。

look.help.brows.en: Tilt the eyebrows. One way looks cross, the other looks sad.
look.help.brows.es: Inclina las cejas. Un lado se ve enfadado, el otro triste.
look.help.brows.zh-Hans: 让眉毛倾斜。一边看起来生气，另一边看起来难过。

look.help.eyes.note: Help of the eye size slider.
look.help.eyes.en: Make the eyes smaller or bigger.
look.help.eyes.es: Hace los ojos más grandes o pequeños.
look.help.eyes.zh-Hans: 让眼睛变得更小或更大。

look.help.squint.en: Squeeze the eyes tight, or open them wide.
look.help.squint.es: Aprieta los ojos, o los abre mucho.
look.help.squint.zh-Hans: 把眼睛眯紧，或者睁得很大。

look.help.horns.en: Turn the horns up or down.
look.help.horns.es: Gira los cuernos arriba o abajo.

look.help.head.note: Help of the head tilt slider.
look.help.head.en: Tilt the head to one side or the other.
look.help.head.es: Inclina la cabeza hacia un lado o hacia el otro.

look.help.pace.en: How quickly it does everything. 1.0 is normal.
look.help.pace.es: Qué tan rápido hace todo. 1.0 es lo normal.
look.help.pace.zh-Hans: 它做所有事的快慢。1.0 是正常。

personality.help.name.en: What you call this Imp. Say its name and it answers.
personality.help.name.es: Cómo llamas a este Imp. Di su nombre y responde.
personality.help.name.zh-Hans: 你怎么称呼这个 Imp。叫它的名字，它就会回答。

personality.help.persona.en: Tell it who to be, like a kind pirate or a quiet helper. It will talk that way.
personality.help.persona.es: Dile quién ser, como un pirata amable o un ayudante callado. Hablará así.
personality.help.persona.zh-Hans: 告诉它要做谁，比如和气的海盗或安静的帮手。它就会那样说话。

personality.help.rules.note: Help of the reply rules switch.
personality.help.rules.en: The hidden rules that tell it how to answer. Most people never change them.
personality.help.rules.es: Las reglas ocultas que le dicen cómo responder. Casi nadie las cambia.
personality.help.rules.zh-Hans: 告诉它怎么回答的隐藏规则。大多数人从不修改。

personality.rules.builtin.note: State of the reply rules when they are the built-in ones.

personality.rules.own.note: State of the reply rules when the user changed them.

personality.rules.edit.note: Button that opens the reply rules in a sheet.

animations.help.list.en: Animations made for only this Imp come first. The shared ones follow: changing one changes it for every Imp.
animations.help.list.es: Primero van las animaciones hechas solo para este Imp. Siguen las compartidas: cambiar una la cambia para todos los Imps.
animations.help.list.zh-Hans: 先是只为这个 Imp 做的动画，后面是共用的动画：修改共用的动画会影响所有 Imp。

tools.help.mcp.note: Help of the extra tools list.
tools.help.mcp.en: Extra tools added from outside. Each one gives the Imp new things to do.
tools.help.mcp.es: Herramientas extra añadidas de fuera. Cada una da al Imp cosas nuevas que hacer.
tools.help.mcp.zh-Hans: 从外面加进来的额外工具。每个都让 Imp 多会一些事。

tools.help.server.note: Help of a tool server badge.
tools.help.server.en: A program or website that gives the Imp more tools.
tools.help.server.es: Un programa o sitio web que da más herramientas al Imp.
tools.help.server.zh-Hans: 给 Imp 提供更多工具的程序或网站。

tools.help.browser.en: Lets the Imp look at pages and use the browser you opened for it.
tools.help.browser.es: Deja al Imp ver páginas y usar el navegador que le abriste.
tools.help.browser.zh-Hans: 让 Imp 查看网页，并使用你为它打开的浏览器。

triggers.help.list.en: A trigger wakes the Imp up by itself when something happens, like a time or a low battery.
triggers.help.list.es: Un disparador despierta al Imp solo cuando pasa algo, como una hora o poca batería.
triggers.help.list.zh-Hans: 触发器会在发生某件事时自动叫醒 Imp，比如到了某个时间或电量低。

triggers.help.name.en: A name so you can find it again.
triggers.help.name.zh-Hans: 一个名字，方便以后找到它。

triggers.help.when.en: What has to happen to set it off, like a time, an app or a low battery.
triggers.help.when.es: Lo que tiene que pasar para activarlo, como una hora, una app o poca batería.
triggers.help.when.zh-Hans: 要发生什么才会触发，比如时间、某个应用或电量低。

triggers.help.do.en: The steps the Imp runs, in order, when it goes off.
triggers.help.do.es: Los pasos que el Imp ejecuta, en orden, cuando se activa.
triggers.help.do.zh-Hans: 触发时 Imp 按顺序执行的步骤。

triggers.follow.note: Row of the trigger editor: how the Imp follows the cursor.

triggers.help.speed.note: Help of the follow speed slider of a follow trigger.
triggers.help.speed.en: How fast it goes after the pointer. Only for Hop and Glide.
triggers.help.speed.es: Qué tan rápido va tras el puntero. Solo para Saltito y Deslizarse.
triggers.help.speed.zh-Hans: 它追指针有多快。只对蹦跳和滑行有用。

triggers.help.for.note: Help for the For choice in the trigger editor.
triggers.help.for.en: Which Imp does the job. A change here is for this Imp alone unless you pick Every Imp.
triggers.help.for.es: Qué Imp hace el trabajo. Un cambio aquí es solo para este Imp, salvo que elijas Todos los Imps.
triggers.help.for.zh-Hans: 由哪个 Imp 来做。除非选择所有 Imp，这里的更改只对这个 Imp 生效。

anim.help.hop.en: How high the Imp jumps in this beat.
anim.help.hop.es: Qué tan alto salta el Imp en este tiempo.
anim.help.hop.zh-Hans: Imp 在这一拍里跳多高。

anim.help.tilt.en: How far the Imp leans to the side.
anim.help.tilt.es: Cuánto se inclina el Imp hacia un lado.

anim.help.shape.en: Squash or stretch the body, like a ball.
anim.help.shape.es: Aplasta o estira el cuerpo, como una pelota.
anim.help.shape.zh-Hans: 把身体压扁或拉长，像个球。

anim.help.symbol.en: A small picture that pops up beside the Imp.
anim.help.symbol.es: Un dibujo pequeño que aparece junto al Imp.
anim.help.symbol.zh-Hans: 在 Imp 旁边冒出来的小图案。

anim.help.beats.en: Each chip is one moment of the move. Drag to move it or stretch it.
anim.help.beats.es: Cada ficha es un momento del movimiento. Arrastra para moverla o estirarla.
anim.help.beats.zh-Hans: 每个小块是动作中的一个瞬间。拖动来移动或拉长它。

anim.help.name.en: A name so you can find it again.
anim.help.name.zh-Hans: 一个名字，方便以后找到它。

anim.help.about.en: One sentence about what it does.
anim.help.about.es: Una frase sobre lo que hace.
anim.help.about.zh-Hans: 用一句话说明它的作用。

anim.help.icon.en: The picture shown for this move in lists.
anim.help.icon.es: El dibujo de este movimiento en las listas.
anim.help.icon.zh-Hans: 这个动作在列表里显示的图案。

kit.help.paste.note: Help of the kit paste field.
kit.help.paste.en: Paste a kit, a web address or an imp:// link, or drop a file. You look at it first.
kit.help.paste.es: Pega un kit, una dirección web o un enlace imp://, o suelta un archivo. Primero lo revisas.
kit.help.paste.zh-Hans: 粘贴一个套件、网址或 imp:// 链接，或放入文件。你会先查看。

kit.help.chats.en: Also copy what this Imp talked about.
kit.help.chats.es: Copia también de lo que habló este Imp.
kit.help.chats.zh-Hans: 同时复制这个 Imp 聊过的内容。

kit.help.tools.en: Tools can run things on your Mac. Read them first.
kit.help.tools.es: Las herramientas pueden ejecutar cosas en tu Mac. Léelas primero.
kit.help.tools.zh-Hans: 工具可以在你的 Mac 上运行东西。请先看一看。

kit.help.skipped.en: Things in the kit this Mac cannot use, so they are left out.
kit.help.skipped.es: Cosas del kit que este Mac no puede usar, por eso se dejan fuera.
kit.help.skipped.zh-Hans: 套件里这台 Mac 用不了的东西，所以被略过。

brain.choose.note: Primary button of a sleeping Imp's Brain panel when services exist but none is chosen.

scope.every_imp.note: Under a trigger or animation shared by every Imp, and the choice that makes a change for every Imp.

scope.only.note: Under a trigger or animation only this Imp has.

scope.changed.note: Under this Imp's own version of a shared trigger or animation. The other Imps keep the shared one.

triggers.new.note: Title of the sheet that adds a trigger.

triggers.scope.just.note: Choice in the trigger editor: the change is for this Imp only.

triggers.scope.note_version.note: Below the For choice when a shared trigger is saved for one Imp.
triggers.scope.note_version.en: Saves a version for {name} only. The other Imps keep the shared one.
triggers.scope.note_version.es: Guarda una versión solo para {name}. Los demás Imps conservan la compartida.
triggers.scope.note_version.zh-Hans: 只为 {name} 保存一个版本。其他 Imp 保留共享的那个。

triggers.scope.note_every.note: Below the For choice when the change goes to every Imp.
triggers.scope.note_every.es: Lo cambia para todos los Imps.
triggers.scope.note_every.zh-Hans: 会对所有 Imp 生效。

triggers.just_for.note: Menu item on a shared trigger: make this Imp's own version. The other Imps keep the shared one.

triggers.share_every.note: Menu item on this Imp's trigger: share it with every Imp.

triggers.use_shared.note: Button that removes this Imp's version of a shared trigger, so the shared one applies again.

triggers.use_shared.title.note: Confirmation before removing this Imp's version of a shared trigger.

triggers.use_shared.message.note: Under the confirmation: the Imp's own version is removed.
triggers.use_shared.message.zh-Hans: 只属于 {name} 的版本将被删除。

triggers.delete_every.note: Destructive action on a shared trigger: delete it for every Imp.

triggers.delete_every.title.note: Confirmation before deleting a shared trigger for every Imp.

brain.model_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the model field: the exact name of a model.

brain.choose_model.note: Help of the list button inside the model field: pick from the service's models.
brain.choose_model.es: Elegir entre los modelos del servicio
brain.choose_model.zh-Hans: 从服务提供的模型中选择

brain.unnamed.note: A service with no name yet.

tools.shared_setup.note: In the extra tool editor: its setup is shared, while each Imp switches it on or off for itself.
tools.shared_setup.en: Every Imp that uses this tool gets this setup. Each Imp switches it on or off for itself.
tools.shared_setup.es: Todos los Imps que usan esta herramienta reciben esta configuración. Cada Imp la activa o desactiva por su cuenta.
tools.shared_setup.zh-Hans: 使用这个工具的每个 Imp 都会得到这套设置。每个 Imp 各自开启或关闭它。

look.swatch.note: Spoken label of a colour swatch in an Imp's look.
look.swatch.zh-Hans: 第 {index} 种颜色，共 {count} 种

tools.new_server.note: Title of a tool server that has no name or address yet.

tools.server_name.note: Label of a tool server's name field.

tools.optional.note: Placeholder of a field that may be left empty.

tools.headers.note: Small title over a tool server's HTTP headers.

tools.header_name.note: Label of a header's name field.

tools.header_value.note: Label of a header's value field.

tools.header_saved.note: Placeholder of a header value that is already kept safe.

tools.header_add.note: Button that adds a header to a tool server.

tools.remove_header.note: Spoken label of the button that removes a header.

tools.remove_server.note: Button and dialog title: remove a tool server from an Imp.

tools.remove_server.message.note: Message of the dialog that removes a tool server.
tools.remove_server.message.en: The Imp loses the tools of this server.
tools.remove_server.message.es: El Imp pierde las herramientas de este servidor.
tools.remove_server.message.zh-Hans: Imp 将不能再用这台服务器的工具。

tools.problem.address.note: Problem on a tool server with no address.

memory.sends.title.note: Row in the Imp's Memory card.

memory.sends.info.en: How many of the latest messages go to the Brain with each one. Fewer is faster and cheaper.
memory.sends.info.es: Cuántos de los últimos mensajes van al cerebro con cada uno. Menos es más rápido y barato.
memory.sends.info.zh-Hans: 每次随消息一起发给大脑的最近消息数。越少越快也越省。

memory.last.note: Choice for Sends: the last N messages.

memory.tools.title.note: Row in the Imp's Memory card.

memory.tools.info.en: Also sends what the tools did and returned. Off is smaller and cheaper.
memory.tools.info.es: También envía lo que hicieron y devolvieron las herramientas. Apagado es más pequeño y barato.
memory.tools.info.zh-Hans: 同时发送工具的操作和返回内容。关闭后更小更省。

memory.new_chat.title.note: Row in the Imp's Memory card.

memory.new_chat.info.en: How big a chat gets before the Imp suggests a recap or a new chat.
memory.new_chat.info.es: Cuánto crece un chat antes de que el Imp sugiera un resumen o un chat nuevo.
memory.new_chat.info.zh-Hans: 聊天达到多大时 Imp 会建议总结或开始新聊天。

memory.size.k.note: A chat size in thousands of tokens.

memory.size.m.note: A chat size in millions of tokens.

personality.about.note: Field label: a short description of the Imp, which other Imps read to know whom to ask.

personality.about_hint.note: Placeholder of the field about what the Imp is good at.
personality.about_hint.en: Researching on the web, fixing code…
personality.about_hint.es: Investigar en la web, arreglar código…

personality.help.about.note: Help of the field about what the Imp is good at.
personality.help.about.en: One or two lines. The other Imps read it to know whom to ask for what.
personality.help.about.es: Una o dos líneas. Los otros Imps la leen para saber a quién pedirle cada cosa.
personality.help.about.zh-Hans: 一两行字。其他 Imp 会读它，来决定什么事该问谁。

tools.mcp_needs_signin.note: Status of an MCP server that asks the person to sign in.

tools.mcp_sign_in.note: Button on an MCP server in the Tools list: opens the server's sign-in page.

tools.mcp_sign_out.note: Button on an MCP server in the Tools list: forgets the sign-in.

triggers.help.sheet.en: When the event happens and every condition holds, the steps run in order.
triggers.help.sheet.es: Cuando ocurre el evento y se cumplen todas las condiciones, los pasos se ejecutan en orden.
triggers.help.sheet.zh-Hans: 事件发生且所有条件都满足时，按顺序执行各个步骤。

triggers.help.only_if.en: Every condition has to hold at that moment, like the battery being low or the time being late.
triggers.help.only_if.es: Todas las condiciones tienen que cumplirse en ese momento, como poca batería o una hora tardía.
triggers.help.only_if.zh-Hans: 触发的那一刻所有条件都必须满足，比如电量低或时间很晚。

triggers.group.you.note: Event menu group: things the person does.

triggers.group.time.note: Event menu group: things about time.

triggers.group.mac.note: Event menu group: things the Mac does.

triggers.cond.always.note: Menu title when a trigger has no conditions.

triggers.cond.add.note: Menu title that adds a condition.

triggers.cond.remove.note: Help of the button that removes a condition.

triggers.step.remove.note: Help of the button that removes a step.

triggers.step.up.note: Help of the button that moves a step up.

triggers.step.down.note: Help of the button that moves a step down.

triggers.step.ask_ph.note: Placeholder of the instruction of an ask step.
triggers.step.ask_ph.en: What should it do? Say it in your own words.
triggers.step.ask_ph.es: ¿Qué debe hacer? Dilo con tus palabras.
triggers.step.ask_ph.zh-Hans: 它该做什么？用你自己的话说。

triggers.step.clipboard.note: Toggle of an ask step: hand over the clipboard.

triggers.step.say_ph.note: Placeholder of the text of a say step.

triggers.step.pick_animation.note: Animation menu when none is picked yet.

triggers.step.anim_none.note: Animation menu of a sleep or wake step: no animation.

triggers.step.no_animations.note: Animation menu when the Imp has none.

triggers.open.note: Name of the open-something choice for screen readers.

triggers.v.clicks.note: Name of the clicks choice for screen readers.

triggers.v.choice.note: Name of a two-way choice for screen readers.

triggers.v.pick_app.note: Help of the open apps menu.

triggers.problem.keys.note: Problem: a keys trigger has no keys.
triggers.problem.keys.en: Record the keys that set it off.
triggers.problem.keys.es: Graba las teclas que lo activan.

triggers.problem.too_many.en: A trigger has five steps at most.
triggers.problem.too_many.es: Un disparador tiene cinco pasos como máximo.
triggers.problem.too_many.zh-Hans: 一个触发器最多有五个步骤。

triggers.problem.ask.note: Problem: an ask step with nothing to ask.
triggers.problem.ask.en: Write what the Imp should do, or hand over the clipboard.
triggers.problem.ask.es: Escribe lo que debe hacer el Imp, o entrega el portapapeles.
triggers.problem.ask.zh-Hans: 请写下 Imp 该做什么，或附带剪贴板。

triggers.problem.say.note: Problem: a say step with no text.
triggers.problem.say.es: Escribe lo que dice el Imp.
triggers.problem.say.zh-Hans: 请写下 Imp 要说的话。

triggers.problem.play.note: Problem: a play step with no animation.
triggers.problem.play.es: Elige la animación que se reproduce.

triggers.problem.missing.note: Problem: a step names an animation the Imp does not have.
triggers.problem.missing.en: This Imp has no animation called “{name}”.
triggers.problem.missing.es: Este Imp no tiene ninguna animación llamada «{name}».
triggers.problem.missing.zh-Hans: 这个 Imp 没有名为“{name}”的动画。

triggers.hint.animation.note: Hint under an animation: it plays on an event only through a trigger.
triggers.hint.animation.en: To play it on an event, add a trigger.
triggers.hint.animation.es: Para reproducirla en un evento, añade un disparador.
triggers.hint.animation.zh-Hans: 要在某个事件时播放它，请添加触发器。

triggers.hint.button.note: Button that opens a new trigger that plays the animation.

animations.list.note: Header of the list of the animations an Imp plays.

tools.new_server_title.note: Title of the sheet that adds an MCP server.

tools.kind.note: Spoken name of the choice between a web server and a local program, in the sheet that adds a tool.

agent.button.note: Tooltip of the wand button in a section header: opens what the Imp may do there by itself.
agent.button.es: Lo que {name} puede hacer por su cuenta

agent.title.note: Title of the sheet with the Imp's own tools of one section.

agent.help.en: The things it can do by itself here. A tool that is off is never offered to its Brain.
agent.help.es: Lo que puede hacer por su cuenta aquí. Una herramienta apagada nunca se ofrece a su Cerebro.
agent.help.zh-Hans: 它在这里可以自己做的事。关闭的工具不会提供给它的大脑。

agent.on.note: Spoken value of the wand button: some tools are on.

agent.off.note: Spoken value of the wand button: every tool there is off.

computer.access.note: Header of the Computer section of an Imp.

computer.help.access.en: What the Imp may reach on this Mac.
computer.help.access.es: Lo que el Imp puede usar en este Mac.
computer.help.access.zh-Hans: Imp 可以在这台 Mac 上使用的东西。

computer.help.senses.en: Reads the battery, processor, network and open apps, and the page open in the browser.
computer.help.senses.es: Lee la batería, el procesador, la red y las apps abiertas, y la página abierta en el navegador.
computer.help.senses.zh-Hans: 读取电池、处理器、网络和打开的应用，以及浏览器中打开的页面。

computer.help.control.note: Help of the Computer control switch.
computer.help.control.en: Sees and operates other apps. Needs the Screen & System Audio Recording and Accessibility permissions.
computer.help.control.es: Ve y maneja otras apps. Necesita los permisos de Grabación de pantalla y audio del sistema y de Accesibilidad.
computer.help.control.zh-Hans: 查看并操作其他应用。需要“屏幕与系统音频录制”和“辅助功能”权限。

tooltext.edit.note: Help of the pencil on a tool's row.
tooltext.edit.en: Change what the model reads about this tool
tooltext.edit.es: Cambiar lo que el modelo lee de esta herramienta
tooltext.edit.zh-Hans: 更改模型读到的这个工具的内容

tooltext.edited.note: Mark on a tool whose name or description was changed.
tooltext.edited.en: Its name or description was changed
tooltext.edited.es: Se cambió su nombre o descripción
tooltext.edited.zh-Hans: 它的名称或说明已更改

tooltext.name.note: Label of the name field in the tool text sheet.
tooltext.name.es: Nombre con el que el modelo la llama

tooltext.name_invalid.es: Usa de 1 a 64 letras, dígitos, _ o -.
tooltext.name_invalid.zh-Hans: 请使用 1 到 64 个字母、数字、_ 或 -。

tooltext.name_taken.en: Another tool already has this name.
tooltext.name_taken.es: Otra herramienta ya tiene este nombre.
tooltext.name_taken.zh-Hans: 另一个工具已使用此名称。

tooltext.description.note: Label of the description editor in the tool text sheet.

tooltext.description_empty.en: Empty. The tool is offered with no description.
tooltext.description_empty.es: Vacío. La herramienta se ofrece sin descripción.
tooltext.description_empty.zh-Hans: 为空。该工具将不带说明提供给模型。

tooltext.reset.note: Button that restores a tool's own name and description.

tooltext.id.note: Label before a tool's id in the sheet that edits its name and description: the id stays the same whatever name is typed.

tooltext.from_server.note: Line in the tool text sheet of an MCP tool.
tooltext.from_server.en: The default name and description come from the server “{server}”.
tooltext.from_server.es: El nombre y la descripción predeterminados vienen del servidor «{server}».
tooltext.from_server.zh-Hans: 默认的名称和说明来自服务器“{server}”。

tooltext.dropped.note: Warning when an edit removed a placeholder the default description had.
tooltext.dropped.en: The default also had {list}, which this text no longer has.
tooltext.dropped.es: El texto predeterminado también tenía {list}, que este texto ya no incluye.
tooltext.dropped.zh-Hans: 默认说明还包含 {list}，当前文本已不再包含。

tooltext.placeholder.imps.en: The other Imps it can message, with what each says about itself.
tooltext.placeholder.imps.es: Los demás Imps a los que puede escribir, con lo que cada uno dice de sí mismo.
tooltext.placeholder.imps.zh-Hans: 它可以发消息的其他 Imp，以及各自的自我介绍。
